context: Tests that deploy.md correctly branches on customer.deployTarget == 'shared': skips D.2-D.5 (new Cloudflare account intake, repo identity rename, new secrets store push, new remote D1 migration) entirely since nothing new is being provisioned, while D.1 (bypass gate) still applies unconditionally. Guards against defaulting to full new-customer provisioning for a demo reusing shared infrastructure, and against skipping the security-critical bypass gate.
